$comment: Field definitions for the ARA catchment layers (ARA_EZG_<year>). Referenced by datapackage.json rather than repeated in each of the seven yearly resources, so a correction is made once.

fields.name: ARA_Nr
fields.title: Plant number
fields.description: Identification number of the treatment plant, following FOEN numbering unless the Comment field says otherwise.

fields.name: alternative_ARA_Nr
fields.title: Alternative plant number
fields.description: Identification number used by VSA or by a canton where it differs from the FOEN number. The source readme listed this field twice, which may mean there are two such columns rather than one; see eawag:pending.

fields.name: Comment
fields.title: Comment
fields.description: Notes on any change to ARA_Nr, for example where FOEN and cantonal numbering differ.

eawag:pending: Confirm whether alternative_ARA_Nr is one column or two, and if two, their distinct names and meanings.
Confirm the missing-value convention actually used in the files, then add a missingValues array to this schema.
The source readme stated that redundant variables were omitted, so this layer may hold further columns. Confirm against the files and add what is missing.
